Your video is too large for direct upload

We can’t upload this file directly because it exceeds our current 50 MB limit. To add this video to Tribal Knowledge Hub, follow these steps:


Step 1 – Open the TKH Uploads folder
Click TKH Uploads folder to open the shared Google Drive folder in a new tab.
(Use the button below to open it.)


Step 2 – Upload your video to the folder
In the TKH Uploads folder:
• Click the New button in the top left corner of Google Drive.
• Choose File upload.
• Select your video file and wait for the upload to finish.
(Note: drag and drop is not supported for this workflow; please use New → File upload.)


Step 3 – Get a shareable link
After the upload completes:
• Right-click your video file in the TKH Uploads folder.
• Click Share → Share.
• Under “General access”, choose Instacart.
• Click Copy link.


Step 4 – Paste the link in TKH
Return to this TKH upload form:
• Paste the link into the URL field.
• Click Upload to save your content to TKH.


For step-by-step instructions with screenshots, open: Large File Upload Instructions

Note: We removed the oversized file you selected, but we kept your title, description, and keywords so you don’t have to re-enter them.
